name: Fourth-ITPR domain-bait scan
description: Find candidate novel ITPR paralogs by listing every UniProt protein InterPro annotates with an IP3R-family Pfam domain (PF08709 Ins145_P3_rec, PF01365 RIH, PF08454 RIH_assoc, PF02815 MIR), excluding those already named ITPR1/2/3 and the ryanodine receptors. The remainder is the candidate pool for the discovery scorer. Verified 2026-08-18: all four domains are shared with RyR, so the RyR exclusion and the size band are load-bearing, not cosmetic.
